WorkspaceInvite.title: You’re invited to {workspace}
WorkspaceInvite.body: Review your access, then accept this invitation.
WorkspaceInvite.noTools: No tools are assigned yet. A workspace administrator can add access later.
WorkspaceInvite.name: Full name
WorkspaceInvite.passwordHelp: Use at least 8 characters. This creates your account; existing accounts keep their password.
WorkspaceInvite.activationHelp: Choose a password to activate your invited account. The workspace administrator has already added your details.
WorkspaceInvite.signInBody: Sign in with {email} to accept. Your existing account and password stay the same.
WorkspaceInvite.wrongAccount: This invitation is for {email}. Sign in with that email to continue.
WorkspaceInvite.signedIn: You’re signed in as {email}. Accepting adds this workspace without changing your other workspace access.
WorkspaceInvite.readyBody: Your invitation to {workspace} has been accepted. Choose when to open it.
WorkspaceInvite.invalidBody: This link is incomplete or no longer available. Ask the workspace administrator for a new invitation.
WorkspaceInvite.expiredBody: Ask the workspace administrator to resend the invitation. This link can’t grant access anymore.
WorkspaceInvite.cancelledBody: The workspace administrator cancelled this invitation. Ask them for a new link if you still need access.
WorkspaceInvite.inactiveBody: An administrator must reactivate your account before you can accept. This invitation can’t reset or reactivate an existing account.
WorkspaceInvite.readOnly: Invitations can’t be accepted while viewing as another person. Return to your own account first.
WorkspaceInvite.loadFailedBody: Your invitation could not be checked. Try again when your connection is available.
WorkspaceInvite.acceptFailed: We couldn’t confirm acceptance. Your form is still here; try again.
WorkspaceInvite.lostResponseRecovery: If your account was already created, sign in with the password you just chose and reopen this invitation.
WorkspaceInvite.signInRequired: Sign in with the invited email to continue. If you just created an account, use the password you chose.
WorkspaceInvite.unavailable: This invitation is no longer available. Its current status is being checked.
WorkspaceInvite.openFailed: You’ve accepted the invitation, but the workspace could not be opened. Try Open workspace again.
